description: Talk to Linus — orchestrates the full pipeline from Jira ticket to verified build spec to implementation. Presents [JF]/[CS]/[RS]/[DS]/[BF]/[PR] and dispatches to the capability skills; also chains them for an end-to-end run.
args: {TICKET-KEY or brief file}
outputs: Orchestrated run across the capability skills

description: Detect tech stack and install coding standards and review rules. Runs automatically before [CS] when standards are missing; also available manually to reinstall or refresh.
args: {-H: headless mode}
outputs: docs/CLAUDE/code-standards/<tech>.md + .github/review-rules/<tech>.md

description: Fetch Jira ticket details, related tickets, and discover Figma links.
args: {TICKET-KEY: ticket to fetch}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Jira ticket data + related-tickets + optional Figma designs

description: Produce a validated build spec — context, coverage, scenarios, tasks, and a definitions.json handoff to the MCP — gated by cs-generate-definitions.py.
args: {TICKET-KEY: ticket to spec}|{-H: headless mode}|{-i: interactive checkpoints}|{--no-party}|{--no-edge-cases}|{--no-adversarial}|{--yolo}
outputs: Buildable spec folder (spec.md + context.md + coverage.md + scenarios.gherkin + tasks.md + definitions.json)

description: Archive a completed spec and produce a fresh one with prior context carried forward.
args: {FEATURE-ID: feature to re-spec}|{--yes: skip destructive confirmation}
outputs: Archived prior spec + fresh spec with primer

description: Full build-review-verify loop — worktree creation, build subagent, review, and Figma compliance check. Invoked automatically from [CS] interactive mode; also available directly.
args: {FEATURE-ID: feature to develop}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Build results + review findings + verify evidence

description: Generate one Playwright E2E test for a completed change — gated on an existing Xray definition (HARD STOP if none). Explores the live UI, maps each Xray step to a test.step(), verifies green and commits. Runs between [DS] and [PR]; only applies to Jira-sourced specs.
args: {FEATURE-ID, spec folder, or TICKET-KEY}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: One verified Playwright spec (*.spec.ts) + page objects, committed; or a logged skip/ABORT when no Xray definition exists

description: Fix a bug test-first — reproduce it, write a test that fails for the right reason, make the minimal fix, and confirm the full suite stays green. Chains [JF] when given a ticket key. Stops before commit/push (review and push are a separate workflow).
args: {TICKET-KEY, bug-report file, or description}
outputs: Verified fix + bug-fix.md handoff (reproduction, root cause, why tests missed, verification)

description: Open a pull request — enforce the repo's review-rules on the diff, confirm the suite is green, sync with the base branch, commit, push, and open the PR. Consumes [BF]'s bug-fix.md handoff. Stops at an open PR — no merge.
args: {handoff file, TICKET-KEY, or working-tree changes}
outputs: Open pull request against the base branch (description with summary, test evidence, ticket link)

description: Review local changes against the repo's styleguide review rules (.ai/Code Reviews/styleguides or .github/review-rules) — the same rules the GitHub PR-review Action applies. Writes a findings report; never posts to a PR or edits code.
args: {--base ref}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Findings report by severity (review-<branch>-<date>.md)

description: Talk to Grace — drives the whole test-automation lifecycle off the Xray backlog: set up topology & standards, fetch definitions, gate them for conformance, build single tests and bulk-backfill folders of verified Playwright tests through the shared E2E pipeline, validate test quality, verify with HMAC evidence, sync results to Xray, and report coverage. Presents [SU]/[FT]/[AT]/[BT]/[BK]/[US]/[RP]/[XC]/[TV] and dispatches to the capability skills.
args: {Xray folder or test ID}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Orchestrated run across the test-automation capability skills

description: Discover and persist the test topology — what is under test, where tests live, where Xray definitions land — and establish test standards. Re-runnable whenever the environment changes.
args: {re-run anytime to refresh topology}
outputs: Persisted test topology and standards in .env / config

description: Pull Xray test definitions for a chosen folder via the Xray MCP and store them under XRAY_OUTPUT_DIR.
args: {folder: Xray folder to fetch}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Synced Xray definitions under XRAY_OUTPUT_DIR + zero-step blocker flags

description: Dashboard of test lifecycle states from the test-lifecycle MCP server — what's pending, building, blocked, verified.
args: {folder: scope dashboard}|{XRAY-ID: one test}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Lifecycle dashboard (pending / building / blocked / verified counts)

description: Batch-backfill automated Playwright tests for an Xray folder — seed the lifecycle server, fan out parallel subagents through the shared E2E pipeline, verify server-side with HMAC evidence, poll, park, remediate, and report.
args: {folder: Xray folder to backfill}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Batch of verified Playwright specs + backfill report

description: Sync local test results back to Xray — mark tests automated/passing via the Xray MCP write-back verb.
args: {folder or XRAY-ID: scope sync}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Xray tickets marked automated/passing via the Xray MCP

description: Coverage and status report across the backlog; optionally attach evidence to Xray tickets via the Xray MCP.
args: {folder: scope report}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Coverage/status report across the backlog

description: Run the Xray step-conformance review for a single Xray test ID or a folder — fetch the definition fresh, read stepCount, and report conformant (>=1 step) or non-conformant. Generates no test. Shared as the pre-generation gate inside [ET].
args: {XRAY-ID or folder}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Per-test conformance verdict (conformant / non-conformant); no test generated

description: Score one Playwright *.spec.ts (or a folder/glob) against the anti-flakiness best-practice rubric, report per-test findings with severity and line refs, then offer to auto-fix the mechanically-fixable ones under confirmation. Generates no test. Shared as the post-fidelity gate inside [ET].
args: {spec file, folder, or glob}|{-H: headless mode}
outputs: Per-test validation report (compliant / findings with severity + line refs); optional confirmed auto-fix; no test generated

description: Capture a TODO as a grounded, plan-goal-ready brief — interview the requester, probe the codebase for real file paths and current behaviour, and write _bmad-output/todos/<slug>.md so a fresh context can pick it up cold. Also lists the open backlog and archives completed TODOs. Writes the brief only; it never implements it and never runs [PL].
args: {create <description> | list | done <slug>}
outputs: Grounded TODO brief (_bmad-output/todos/<slug>.md) + an updated TODOS.md index

description: Talk to Hannibal — plans any task into an approval-gated decision document, prepares the approved plan into a worktree-hosted goal folder with an enforced acceptance contract, pursues it under the stop gate until every criterion is met and evidenced, and hands an active goal to a fresh context. Presents [PL]/[PG]/[PU]/[HO]/[ST]/[GG] and dispatches to the stage skills; [ST] derives every goal's status from disk.
args: {task, brief file, slug, .goal path, or handover.md path}
outputs: Orchestrated run across the goal stage skills + derived goal status

description: Hannibal stage 1 — plan a task into _bmad-output/goals/<slug>.goal/plan.md: one Decision block per choice (choice, workflow, justification, alternatives), workflows picked from the disk-verified decision matrix, the light/heavy lane call, and the worktree decision. Runs research inline where a decision needs evidence. Stops at the user-approval gate and writes the .approved marker only on the user's explicit word. Plans only — it neither prepares nor executes.
args: {task description or brief file}
outputs: Goal folder with plan.md + copied prompt; .approved marker on user approval

description: Hannibal stage 2 — build an APPROVED plan into an executable workstream: verify the .approved marker and the plan hash (refusing drift; --force is the recorded OVERRIDE), create the decided worktree on goal/<slug>, MOVE the goal folder in (leaving a .moved stub), run the plan's bound workflows into the folder — the SPEC via [CS] on the heavy lane, directly-written ACs on the light lane — and emit the hardened charter, acceptance contract, and auto-start files. Prepares only — it does not execute the charter.
args: {slug or goal-folder path}|{--force: approve as OVERRIDE}
outputs: Prepared X.goal/ in its worktree (goal.md + ACs.md + spec/ or honest manifest + auto-start files) + .moved stub in the main checkout

description: Hannibal stage 3 — start work on a prepared X.goal/ folder under a stop gate that refuses to let the session end while any acceptance criterion is outstanding — or ticked without evidence. Follows a .moved stub to the canonical worktree copy and refuses the main-checkout ghost. Binds the folder, writes loop state, and yields; the gate then runs at every turn end. Triggers on any reference to a .goal path — naming the folder is enough to start it. Does not create the folder — that is [PG].
args: {path to an X.goal/ folder, or its .moved stub}
outputs: Bound goal loop; the stop gate blocks turn-end until every criterion is met and evidenced

description: Hand an active goal to a fresh context without weakening the stop gate. [HO] writes the goal's current operating context to handover.md. Referring to that file in a fresh context adopts the active loop, or invokes [PU] only when no active loop remains.
args: {an X.goal/ folder to create a handover | its handover.md to resume}
outputs: Current handover document or a safely adopted goal loop

description: Inspect or end a goal loop that is ALREADY running — report what the stop gate is doing, why a turn is not ending, and cancel the run if asked. Cancelling is a reported end, never a completion: unmet criteria stay unmet and nothing is ticked.
args: {status | cancel}
outputs: Loop status report (workstream, iteration, met/outstanding counts, recent decisions) or a reported cancellation

description: Per-workstream run journal — capture the outcome of a spike, investigation, deploy, or experiment so subsequent runs of the same workstream can be briefed on what was tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do differently.
args: {journal this | brief me from the journal | record this run}
outputs: Per-workstream journal entry (what was tried / worked / failed / next steps)

description: Audit the repository against a 50-check security checklist (secrets, auth and access, input and data, AI and agents, failure handling, supply chain and CI, headers) and write a ranked report plus a remediation plan. Read-only; the plan feeds [PL] and is never executed by the scan.
args: {-H: headless mode} {optional path filter}
outputs: report.md + remediation-plan.md + findings.json under security-scans/<date>/
